notes.title: File 04 is Here!
notes.content:
Note: This update may break old saves as it contains improvements to previous Files!

In this update...

[h1]File 04[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/7199a0676cb2d8013fad1aedde445f453e90d063.png[/img]

In the final round of Stage Four, Team Tads investigates a series of murders at the Hopewell Rocks in New Brunswick. But the nature of the crime may not be as it first appeared... Will they solve the most complicated mystery yet?

Please note that the price of the game will increase after this week.

[h1]Theory/Interrogation QoL Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/ee6b12193f39850081aef3309d09115987c43fea.png[/img]

Evidence is now separated into "pages" that you can easily access by clicking the page number tabs. You can also use A/D or arrow keys to quickly cycle through them. I hope that this makes it less frustrating to get to the evidence you want — and makes the game more accessible to people playing with trackpads or smaller screens.

I've also replaced the "triangle arrow" design for the submit button with "Submit!" text for all Theory/Interrogation/Support puzzles, as the design wasn't really clear enough and resulted in some confusion.

[h1]Smaller Improvements![/h1]

[list]
[*] Some of Struess's dialog in Hangout Three changed to be more "hacker accurate".
[*] The currently highlighted Hangout in the Hangouts menu now has a visual indicator that it is being highlighted.
[*] Game-master did not announce the names of the mysteries in File 02 & 03, this has been corrected.
[*] In File 01, the footage is now locked until you have the evidence you need to proceed, avoiding some backtracking issues
[/list]

Enjoy File 04, and I hope you look forward to the next release... ;)

Best,

— LockedOn & Erabit

notes.title: File 03 is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/2557ac3c75220018ccc84652663349e490c0e82f.jpg[/img]

Note: This update may break old saves as it contains improvements to previous Files!

In this update...

[h1]File 03[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/3b93f8831ede73b34d24494f526b637e3fa8f81b.png[/img]

In the most intriguing mystery yet, Team Tads heads to Iqaluit to investigate a brutal murder in a museum, created by Team Nailbiter. It's the first match-up between Larika and Joane... who will win!?

[b]Please note that the price of the game will increase after this week.[/b]

[h1]Support System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/0f3be5084ff4740cea160060f017259cc537df24.png[/img]

There is a new gameplay mechanic, "Support", which is very similar to "Theory", however this time you are supporting your teammate's argument with evidence instead of disproving it! There were previously Theory puzzles in File 02 which were solved by supporting statements instead of disproving them, which was inconsistent and therefore confusing — those have now been replaced with Support puzzles. 

[h1]Updated Casefile[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/0db9d60993f589cf8b5539f4c2133b788c058bec.png[/img]

The old casefile tried to cram everything in one screen, and large sections of it were just empty space for most of the mystery. The new casefile is sleeker and tidier, with separate tabs for the case summary, bios of suspects and victims, evidence, and autopsy information. 

You can now click the arrows in the corner of the photo of the crime scene to cycle between various images of the mystery as you discover them.

There's also now a little bio about each suspect and victim to refresh your memory about them, and you can click the dummy icon on their profile picture to see what they look like as dummies, making it easier to identify them.

[h1]Quick-Switching for Morale[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/495d78990e0bfc27e54527474727bc579b9a3ed7.png[/img]

If you're one of the players who likes to unlock the outfits, maybe you've gotten annoyed that in order to unlock those outfits, you may have ended up with certain characters hating you or liking you, and had to replay the Hangout a third time to get them back to where you wanted.

Now once you've unlocked a character's two routes in a Hangout, you can click the "Smile" or "Frown" icons to quickly switch the character to liking you or hating you!

You can also now click the shirt icon to open the Outfits menu and try on their unlocked outfit!

Smaller Improvements!
[list]
[*] CG Gallery added
[*] Interrogation/Theorize layout and text size updated to reduce the need for scrolling on evidence descriptions
[*] Tads' hair is no longer cut off at the top when he is transitioning between standing/sitting poses
[*] Scoring System readjusted
[/list]

Enjoy File 03, and I hope you look forward to the release of Hangout Three... ;)

Best,

— LockedOn & Erabit

notes.title: Devlog 43: Aaaalmost!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/9c8d7020de4ea6017ee0726e39c006829e00d353.png[/img]

File 03 is aaaalmost finished!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/d77147fb8ac92c463fc7a597163cfb68a7958655.png[/img]

Here's what I've done since the last devlog!

[list]
[*] Finished all CGs
[*] Finished all titlecards
[*] Completed half the music tracks needed
[*] Finished and implemented all backgrounds
[*] Added a new menu
[/list]

I'm aiming to complete all the music by the end of the month or very early April, and I feel confident that I can launch the File 03 beta for Patreon/Afdian members within the first two weeks of April. There are more CGs in File 03 than the other ones, so it took a bit of time to work up the motivation to complete them. However, happily I can report that they are done, and finally all the backgrounds are in the game as well.

I do have a whole list of revisions to the mystery to make, which isn't really represented here on the chart. I think I can probably get those done within a week. The Chinese translation is in progress already, and I'm predicting we will be able to release File 03 in the later half of April. Thank you for your patience!

April will be a big month for [i]Methods[/i] — we are releasing chapters 21-40 of the game on mobile named "Methods 2: Secrets and Death", as well as adding a Japanese translation to the first mobile game, [i]The Illusion Murders[/i] will be released for free as a standalone game, and there is the Methods 4th Anniversary update as well. 

Until next time!

— LockedOn.

notes.title: Devlog 41: Heading Down the Runway
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/896571ea212e55fee2da7abea0d2ae1ab30e94e2.png[/img]

The biggest background in File 03 has been finished... and now it's all coming together very quickly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/b6eb7229de5c848759206e0d0bf644b660363ff0.png[/img]

Here's what I've done since the last devlog, where I finished all the sprites for File 03!

[list]
[*] 
[*] Finished the largest background
[*] Coded the expressions for all 5 chapters
[*] Rendered backgrounds for Chapter 12
[*] Implemented backgrounds for Chapter 12
[/list]

I've made a ton of progress since the last devlog. It really feels like the "File 03 plane" is heading down the runway, and now that all these pieces are in place, it won't be long before I'm able to finish it! This was one of the hardest backgrounds to make, perhaps the hardest (the Grouse Mountain's opening area was quite a difficult one...) The reason is that I needed to create many more unique textures, due to the nature of the mystery, and this background actually contains four separate spaces, all in one.

Because this background is the location of the entire mystery, the mystery chapters (12, 13 & 14) will be finished first. They are the hardest, so I'm giving them my priority. I'm currently rendering backgrounds as I write this.

Thanks for your patience, it'll be full steam ahead from here on out. 😉

Until next time!

— LockedOn.

notes.title: File 02 is Here! 🤩
notes.content:
File 02 has been released into Early Access, and the price will increase on Oct 6th, so you will be able to get File 02 at the current price for this week! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/4b7aff43c12db5d7ca805c5db010c38b05d4a063.jpg[/img]

It took a long time, but File 02 has been written, modeled, composed, designed, implemented, tested, and translated — and now is finally in Early Access!

Please note that this update may break your saves, because I've added new systems to File 01.

Speaking of that, this update to the game comes with a few new features and improvements, not just in File 02, but File 01 as well!

[h1]💥Outfits[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/9fe13d0c14b399f154752c42280f99aa935bd5fb.png[/img]

As a reward for completing Hangouts, you now unlock outfits for Team Tads. Hangout One's outfit set, "Casual", is now included! More outfit sets will be released with later Hangouts.

[h1]💥Hangouts[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/35a95598dcb0650269fccec9605fe519445b74bd.png[/img]

The Hangouts now get a special menu where you can see which routes you've unlocked, and navigate to the different Hangouts in the future.

[h1]💥Scoring System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/160d6fba15aa1ce04006175ef7bdd7775a5934fe.png[/img]

Both File 01 and File 02 have a new scoring system with rank "S" as the highest and "F" as the lowest. See how you score!

[h1]💥Hearts System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/409983ce2c83bf5bdf26088c5f916b585137da5d.png[/img]

I've implemented a hearts system to the Interrogation and Theorize puzzles. Every incorrect answer loses a heart. If you run out of hearts, you get the chance to "Auto-fill" the correct answer.

[h1]💥Viu Minigame Updates[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/11bb208b43de085bb2f0de2f5cd32c7b11bae2c6.png[/img]

I've implemented feedback from players about Viu's minigame. Now areas "focus" to highlight where you can find eyes. It makes the minigame a lot easier, especially for people who for some reason play the game with a trackpad instead of a mouse (kudos to you for dealing with that), and hopefully encourages more careful searching as opposed to randomly roaming your mouse around.

[h1]💥Music Room[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/6b6754ea7b1d8d859ae69d46efa3edf0611446f7.png[/img]

The music room is here! Listen to the soundtrack in-game, now with functionality to scrub through the track or pause it.*

[h1]💥Achievements[/h1]
Achievements have now been added to the game!

[h1]Smaller Improvements!🙊🙊[/h1]

[list]
[*] The evidence the dummy is being asked about now appears on screen
[*] "Correct!" sound effect for when you submit the right evidence in Interrogations, select the right toxins in Anadyne's minigame, and as positive feedback for positive answers in Hangouts.
[*] Dummy icon now marks dummy interrogations 
[*] Dummies will now be "locked" until you have found the evidence you need for their interrogation, so that you waste less time backtracking
[*] Added casefile summaries
[*] The amount of evidence you need to select for an Interrogation/Theorize puzzle is now simply a UI element, instead of the characters awkwardly discussing it in the hint.
[*] In Chapter 4, Larika will now only say she "almost submitted the wrong answer" if the player did in fact choose to submit the incorrect answer.
[*] Fixed Anadyne's bio.
[/list]

Thanks for supporting the Early Access! With your feedback, I've been able to make improvements to the game.

Enjoy File 02, and see you soon for the release of Hangout Two... ;)

Best,

— LockedOn.

* Thanks to the Ren'Py Universal Player by GanstaKingofSA

notes.title: [Coming Soon!] Major Update & Price Increase
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After lots of hard work by the translators, File 02 is finally fully translated! I'm happy to announce that File 02 will be releasing within 10 days! Dive into a brand new mystery, as well as many improvements to the game!

Please note that the price will be increasing after File 02's release — but to thank all the players who have Wishlisted and supported the game, you will be able to get File 02 at the current price before Oct 6th!

I know it's been a long time coming, so thank you for your patience! I think this file is even better than File 01, and I'm glad you get to finally play it!

Until next time,

— LockedOn

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 16
notes.content:
Hangouts morale fix:
Recasting your vote in Chapter 4 will now reset the Hangouts properly, readjusting the initial morale values.

Note:
The way the Hangouts work, the person you vote for will have lower morale.
Voting for yourself (Downs) means that everyone will have lower morale.
There is no way to fully fill up the meter for every character. This is by design.

notes.title: The Chinese Translation is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For the past two weeks the Translation Masters and I have been hard at work on the Chinese translation for File 01.

As of right now, you can finally play the first file in Chinese! A huge thank you to them for making this possible in such a short amount of time!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128595/c69df6ec28a7416cff592e03fd21a00892d6cf90.png[/img]

In addition to the Chinese translation, I took this opportunity to implement a few other things. I'm still working my way through all the different feedback I've received, but there are a few quality of life improvements in this update as well!

[list]
[*] Struess mini-game hint! Now hopefully not as many people will be stuck on it for hours!
[*] When submitting evidence, the characters say "need more evidence" or "need less evidence" once you reach the last hint, if you submit too much/too little evidence, to help nudge you in the right direction!
[*] Evidence should now deselect after submitting!
[*] There was a problem with the solution to the mystery, as Anadyne's suggestion would not actually matter in terms of the time of death. Anadyne's explanation has been changed to the next best thing, to resolve this logical hole
[*] Many other little tweaks and typo fixes as well!
[/list]

I decided it was best to get the translation in your hands sooner rather than later, so this update does not include the extras, which I'm still working on implementing.

Thank you so much for your patience everyone. Enjoy!

Until next time!

— LockedOn.

notes.title: Update Notes For Feb 4
notes.content:
This is a small update that adds a few suggested improvements.

New hotkeys!
[list]
[*] Press H for text history screen
[*] Press Q for quick save
[*] Press L for the load screen
[*] Press S for the save screen
[*] Press O/P for the options screen
[*] Press C to open the casefile
[*] Viu's method now works with WASD and arrow keys on keyboard!
[/list]

In addition to that...

[list]
[*] Added new text to Struess and Viu methods to hopefully explain what to do better
[*] Added fullscreen/windowed toggle to the options menu (was previously only available by pressing 'f')
[*] Increased the size of the hitbox on Perspective eye icons and Pinpoint paths to assist people playing on smaller screens
[*] Quality of images increased from 80% to 95%. Now there should be less noticeable artifacts, yet the game is still much smaller (300mbs) than its uncompressed size (700mbs)
[*] Removed 'CHANGE EVERYDAY' from the note you find in the computer as it may have made the note seem more important than it is
[/list]

This game is a work in progress, and I'm going to keep making improvements. I appreciate the feedback!

Thanks!
— LockedOn.
